## Summary

The IEEE registry lists 44 MA-L blocks to Shenzhen YOUHUA Technology
Co., Ltd, the registry string ending in a tab character, at the
Shenzhen University-town Business Park on Lishan Road, Taoyuan Street,
Shenzhen [1]. The company, Shenzhen Youhua Technology Co., Ltd.
(Youhua Communication), was founded in 2012, gives an address in Nanshan, Shenzhen, and
describes itself as a high-tech network communication equipment and
terminal solution provider [2]. Its product lines are wireless
products, family gateways, government and enterprise gateways, family
cloud boxes, Tiantong and Beidou satellite terminals, AI cloud
computing products, home cameras with infrared night vision and two-way
voice, and sensor transmission devices [2][3].

The site shows China Mobile, China Telecom and China Broadcasting
Network as partners and reports procurement wins with China Telecom,
China Mobile Shanghai, China Mobile Guizhou and China Tower, so a MAC
in these blocks is most likely a carrier-supplied home gateway, router
or camera in China [2][3]. Wi-Fi generations, chipsets, FCC grantee
codes and randomisation are not documented: the site lists no model
numbers or standards, the FCC ID databases and web search were
unavailable to the session that wrote this entry, and nothing is
filled in from memory [2].
